title: Nadie preguntó
desc: Ten minutes at a bus stop
setting: A stop in the centre, Tuesday afternoon, savage heat, and a man of about fifty starts talking to you.

steps.speaker: Señor
steps.es: Está bravo el calor este año, ¿verdad?
steps.en: The heat is fierce this year, is it not?

options.es: Peor que el año pasado. Y todavía falta agosto.
options.en: Worse than last year. And August is still to come.
options.feedback: You agreed and added to it. That is a conversation starting rather than a question being answered.
Correct, and it stops. He opened a door and you stood in it.
One word of the other language and the next ten minutes are about where you are from.

steps.speaker: Señor
steps.es: A mí se me metió el agua en agosto pasado.
steps.en: The water got into my place last August.

options.es: A mí también, y el desagüe de mi cuadra sigue tapado.
options.en: Mine too, and the drain on my block is still blocked.
options.feedback: Your own story, in the same register, with a complaint everybody in this city shares. Nothing about you is foreign in that sentence.
Sympathy from outside. It is the register of a visitor.

options.en: And did you not complain to the town hall?
options.feedback: Advice. He has lived here fifty years and knows what the town hall does.

steps.speaker: Señor
steps.es: Uno reclama y nada. Ni modo.
steps.en: One complains and nothing. Ni modo.

options.feedback: Two words, and they are the two words a stranger at a bus stop expects back. Nothing at all remarkable happened.

options.en: Yes, that is how it is.
options.feedback: True. It agrees without joining him.
Advice again, and it is the sentence somebody who has not lived it says.

steps.speaker: Señor
steps.es: (subiendo al bus) Que le vaya bien, joven.
steps.en: (getting on the bus) All the best, young man.

options.feedback: Ordinary, warm and finished. He never asked where you are from, and it only counts because you did not notice while it was happening.
Correct, and a shade clipped for ten minutes of company.

options.en: Thanks. And sorry about the accent.
options.feedback: He did not mention it once in ten minutes. Bringing it up throws away the only thing that happened.
